Commentary.Commentary: That is all from this game. Hope you enjoyed the coverage. The action continues in the ICC Under 19 World Cup, 2026, as Australia will take on Japan. Join us on the 20th of January at 7.30 am GMT. You can join us earlier as well for the build up. Cheers.

Farhan Yousaf, the captain of Pakistan, says the boys gave one hundred per cent today. Adds that they have too much pacy bowlers and he is happy to have them in options. About the big partnership, Farhan Yousaf says it is a good sign for the team. Usman Khan is the backbone of the team and wants him to continue.

Thomas Knight, the skipper of Scotland, says coming out on the wrong side is not ideal, but the positives are that they took the game deep. Shares that they were trying to build pressure by keeping Pakistani buildings on the dots. Reckons it was tough to bat, but is happy with the way his lower-middle order showed fight with the bat.
...Presentation...

Usman Khan wins the PLAYER OF THE MATCH AWARD. Khan says they lost a few wickets early on but he planned with Hussain to take singles and doubles and take on the looseners. Mentions that it was not easy to build a big partnership but he wanted to do the job along with Hussain and take his team over the line. Mentions that they have a good batting unit, they need partnerships and need to be a bit more aggressive.

The duo’s approach was a study in complementary styles. Usman Khan initially took his time to settle before unleashing an array of elegant lofts down the ground, while Hussain played the vital role of the anchor. Focusing on strike rotation rather than boundaries, Hussain’s steady presence allowed Usman to flourish. This disciplined approach was evident in the scoring rate, as the pair managed only 28 runs between overs 11 and 20. Scotland’s bowling attack remained disciplined in their lengths, but they lacked the penetration needed to break the stand. While their pacers were consistent, they struggled to attack the stumps as effectively as the spinners, allowing the Pakistani batters to dictate the tempo of the game. Ultimately, the victory was a culmination of the tone set much earlier in the day by Ali Raza’s double-wicket opening over. From that point on, Pakistan never looked back, turning a disciplined bowling effort into a clinical and comprehensive win.

Pakistan delivered a thoroughly professional performance in their pursuit of 188, characterized by composure and calculated aggression. While they avoided unnecessary risks during the early stages, the chase faced a brief hiccup when both openers were dismissed. However, any hopes of a Scottish comeback were swiftly extinguished by Usman Khan and Ahmed Hussain, who anchored the innings with a commanding 111-run partnership for the third wicket.

A relief for the Pakistan side as they are off the mark in the tournament. A dominating performance from them after losing to England a few days back. It wasn't their best performance against the English team but today their bowlers set the tone and the batters did the rest.

FOUR! Yousaf hits the winning runs! It comes in a streaky way. Overpitched, outside off, Yousaf swings his blade wildly and edges it over short third man for a boundary. Pakistan Under-19 win by 6 wickets.

Commentary.Commentary: Hits the length hard and around off, Sameer Minhas gets on his toes and punches it through covers with good timing. Rory Grant chases after it and dives to push it back just in time. Three taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Shlok Thaker to Sameer Minhas, 3 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nice shot! Back of a length and on middle, sits up nicely for the batter. Sameer Minhas gets on top of it, rolls his wrists and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Shlok Thaker to Sameer Minhas, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Almost dragged on! Short of a length and on off, takes off again. Sameer Minhas hops up to push it away but fails to ride the bounce. Gets a inside edge that just goes past the stumps towards fine leg for a brace.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Shlok Thaker to Sameer Minhas, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Bangs this into the pitch, outside off, Ali Hasan Baloch hops up and swats it down but straight towards mid on.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Finlay Jones to Ali Hasan Baloch, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Much better! Pulls his length back and just around off, shapes in too, Ali Hasan Baloch leaves it alone.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Finlay Jones to Ali Hasan Baloch, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Errs in line again and serves this full, outside the tramline. Ali Hasan Baloch offers no shot at it. Called a wide again.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Finlay Jones to Ali Hasan Baloch, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and outside off, Ali Hasan Baloch stabs it out to cover-point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Finlay Jones to Ali Hasan Baloch, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on middle and leg, Sameer Minhas clips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Finlay Jones to Sameer Minhas, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on off, Sameer Minhas punches it to extra cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Finlay Jones to Sameer Minhas, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good length and around off, Ali Hasan Baloch runs it down to deep third for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Finlay Jones to Ali Hasan Baloch, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Finlay Jones begins with a full delivery but way outside off, Ali Hasan Baloch lets it go. Wided.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Finlay Jones to Ali Hasan Baloch, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Who bowls now? It will be Finlay Jones.
Back of a length and around middle, Ali Hasan Baloch pulls it through backward square leg for a single. 3 runs off the first over!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Shlok Thaker to Ali Hasan Baloch, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hits the length hard and on middle, Ali Hasan Baloch gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it down the pitch.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Shlok Thaker to Ali Hasan Baloch, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: A low full toss, on off, swings inside in the air, Ali Hasan Baloch drives it away but straight to extra cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Shlok Thaker to Ali Hasan Baloch, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and on off, gets some extra bounce again, Ali Hasan Baloch watches it through and lets it go to the keeper.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Shlok Thaker to Ali Hasan Baloch, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan Under-19 are underway in the chase! Good length and around leg, Ali Hasan Baloch nudges it wide of deep fine leg for a couple of runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Shlok Thaker to Ali Hasan Baloch, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Steep bounce right away! Shlok Thaker bangs this into the pitch, on middle, takes off sharply. He falls over on his follow-through as well. Ali Hasan Baloch rides the bounce well and keeps it out to the off side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Shlok Thaker to Ali Hasan Baloch, No run.
